7 انصلت He advanced with a penetrative energy, and outstripped; syn. مَضَى, and سَبَقَ; (K;) or so انصلت فِى سَيْرِهِ [i. e., in his pace]: (S:) he outstripped; syn. تَجَرَّدَ: and he was quick, or he hastened, in his pace, or going. (TA.) One says of the eagle (العُقَاب), انْصَلَتَتْ مُنْقَضَّةً [It was swift in making a stoop]. (A. [This meaning is there indicated by the context.]) ―
-b2- انصلت يَعْدُو He hastened in some measure, running: and so اِنْكَدَرَ يَعْدُو. (A'Obeyd, TA.) ―
-b3- انصلتت السَّحَابَةُ (assumed tropical:) The cloud was going to rain. (TA, from a trad.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
